Sloan-Swartz Centers for Theoretical Neurobiology Annual Summer Meeting 2007

Date: July 28 – July 31, 2007
Location: Eucalyptus Point, UC San Diego
La Jolla, California

The Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience (SCCN) at the University of California, San Diego is hosting the 2007 Sloan-Swartz Center for Theoretical Neurobiology Annual Summer Meeting of students, post-docs, and faculty associated with the Sloan-Swartz Centers at Brandeis, Caltech, NYU, Salk, and UCSF, the Swartz Centers for Computational Neuroscience at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory and UCSD, and the Center for Theoretical Neuroscience at Columbia.

The meeting is sponsored each year by the Sloan and the Swartz Foundations as a part of the Sloan-Swartz Program in Theoretical Neurobiology.

Please see the Conference Details for more detailed information and logistics.
